entries.6a53d58d54c65e4a: The business entrusted operation of call center work and other operations, playing a central role in client companies' CRM promotion. Work is performed either by staff at the company group's centers or jointly with client companies at the clients' centers. The company also operates mother centers that standardize operations and verify new initiatives, and accepts outsourcing of back-office work for digital marketing (Marketing Process Outsourcing). The business is carried out by Virtualex Consulting, Inc. and Virtualex Kyushu Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥2,851 million. Virtualex Kyushu Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Saga City, Saga Prefecture.

entries.cd3e15a893cac8b6: A business centered on consulting services that support companies from planning business strategy, CRM strategy, IT strategy, marketing strategy and the like through to designing and building the operations and systems needed to realize and introduce them. It also provides licence sales of the CRM package product "inspirX" (Inspiri), which gives form to the knowledge built up through consulting and process operations, and stock-type IT services that support companies' CRM infrastructure. It is carried out by Virtualex Consulting Co., Ltd., Time Intermedia Co., Ltd. and VX Act Co., Ltd., and extends to the Web domain, the education and school solutions domain, and support for the use of AI and digital transformation. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥4,028 million. Time Intermedia Co., Ltd. has its head office in Shinjuku-ku, Tokyo.
